        "new_text": "import re\n\ndef redact(value):\n    if isinstance(value, str):\n        # Redact tokens, passwords, api_keys, etc.\n        redacted = re.sub(r'(?i)(authorization|token|password|api_key)\\s*[:=]\\s*[\\w-]+', r'\\1: [REDACTED]', value)\n        return redacted\n    return value"
